§1
Section one
Find the claim in five minutes
The abstract is the trailer, not the film

Three things to highlight in every abstract

Abstract

We show that a small model, asked to re-check its own answer, answers questions correctly 77.5% of the time, compared with 71.2% without the check. This recovers most of the gap to a model ten times larger.

Erratum
The recording says the method "beats the larger model". Table 1 shows it comes close: 77.5% against 78.9%.
Beats the larger model → Comes close, for less
